'''Nank Tun''' was a [[Shi'ido]] who disguised himself as a [[Ualaq/Legends|Ualaq]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] and served [[Po Nudo/Legends|Po Nudo]] throughout the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Shi'ido]] skin-changer, Nank Tun disguised himself as a [[Ualaq/Legends|Ualaq]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] and attached himself to the [[Ando system/Legends|Ando system's]] delegation in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]].<ref name="UIG">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Ultimate Illustrated Guide]]''</ref> Becoming the [[Aide/Legends|aide]] of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Po Nudo/Legends|Po Nudo]], he maintained his disguise even after Nudo withdrew the delegation from the Republic and joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="AOTC" />

As the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], he remained close to Nudo, advising the Aqualish on matters relating to his position on the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] and as head of the [[Hyper-Communications Cartel/Legends|Hyper-Communications Cartel]]. When the Separatist leadership was sent to [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], he joined Nudo and the other leaders at the [[Klegger Corp Mining Facility/Legends|Klegger Corp Mining Facility]] where the Confederacy's mysterious benefactor [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] assured they would be safe. Welcoming Sidious' [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the Shi'ido and the rest of the Separatist Council soon [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|realized they were in danger]]. Cowering alongside Nudo as Vader ignited his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], Nank Tun's decorative breastplate did nothing to stop the blue-bladed weapon as it struck, [[Death/Legends|killing]] him instantly.<ref name="ROTS" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Equipment==
Near the end of the Clone Wars, Tun wore a breast plate that doubled as body armor.<ref name="Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
